bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; appropriating money for town roads and bridges.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. TOWN ROADS; APPROPRIATION.

$25,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $25,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of transportation for town roads, to be distributed in the manner provided under Minnesota Statutes, section 162.081.

Sec. 2. TOWN BRIDGES; APPROPRIATION.

$10,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $10,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of transportation for town bridges, to be distributed in the manner provided under Minnesota Statutes, section 162.081.
